scope: Adversarial — duplicate event injection, broken cascade on listener failure, race between outbox write and broadcast, KDS sees stale/duplicate data, cross-branch broadcast leakage

attacks_attempted.attack: Inject duplicate OrderCreated event for same order_id
attacks_attempted.vector: Trigger event() twice (e.g. retry between OrderService::create and event() call, or queue retry of the listener itself).
attacks_attempted.defense_first: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox:22-48 — firstOrCreate keyed on sha1(event_type|aggregate_id). Second call hits UNIQUE constraint, returns existing row, wasRecentlyCreated=false. Line 57: return; — no second DispatchDomainEventsJob dispatch.
attacks_attempted.defense_second: DispatchDomainEventsJob:65-86 — even if dispatch DID fire twice somehow, the lockForUpdate + dispatched_at guard ensures only one worker broadcasts. Test sentinel: tests/Feature/Outbox/OutboxConcurrentWorkerDedupeTest.php:46-90.

attacks_attempted.attack: Listener throws — does cascade break SSOT?
attacks_attempted.vector: DecrementStockOnOrderCreated throws on Throwable (line 36 — see PK1-ARCH-01).
attacks_attempted.defense_listener_order: EventServiceProvider:147 — PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox is FIRST in OrderCreated subscribers. Outbox row WRITES before Stock listener runs.
attacks_attempted.remaining_risk: Sibling listener SendFcmOnOrderCreated (line 150) does NOT fire if Stock throws because Laravel's default event dispatcher stops on first thrown exception. SendFcm itself is wrapped (safeDispatch :109-120) but parents-level throw skips its handle() entirely.
attacks_attempted.outcome: PARTIAL DEFEAT — outbox SSOT safe (writes first), but FCM kitchen notification can be silently missed if Stock throws. Mitigation: PK-4 should unify listener failure isolation.

attacks_attempted.attack: Race between outbox write commit and broadcast fire
attacks_attempted.vector: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox writes row, then queues DispatchDomainEventsJob inline. If outer transaction rolls back, the row is gone but the job is already queued. Job runs, finds row=null at line 70, returns silently.
attacks_attempted.defense: DispatchDomainEventsJob:70-73 — find() returns null, $skip=true, return. Logged at line 89.
attacks_attempted.outcome: DEFEATED — orphan job is a no-op.

attacks_attempted.attack: Race in reverse — broadcast fires BEFORE outbox row commits
attacks_attempted.vector: If DispatchDomainEventsJob::dispatch is sync (e.g. config queue.default=sync in tests), job runs immediately, lockForUpdate sees uncommitted row (READ COMMITTED isolation) and either misses it OR sees stale dispatched_at.
attacks_attempted.defense: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox:61 — the inline dispatch is wrapped in DB::afterCommit() (line 61). DispatchDomainEventsJob::dispatch only fires AFTER the outer transaction commits. Row is visible to the lockForUpdate at that point.
attacks_attempted.outcome: DEFEATED — afterCommit guard is the defense.

attacks_attempted.attack: Cross-branch leakage via guessed channel name
attacks_attempted.vector: Branch=1 staff subscribes to private-branch.2 to receive competitor orders.
attacks_attempted.defense: routes/channels.php:41-62 — Broadcast::channel('branch.{branchId}', ...) returns false for staff whose branch_id != branchId (line 61). Admin/Tenant Admin role explicitly granted (line 56). Kiosk token name discriminator (line 45) bound to KioskMachine.branch_id.
attacks_attempted.outcome: DEFEATED — explicit auth callback returns false.

attacks_attempted.attack: Sanctum wildcard token bypass via tokenCan
attacks_attempted.vector: Admin token with abilities=['*'] would pass tokenCan('kiosk:order') and route through kiosk auth path → potentially subscribe to wrong branch.
attacks_attempted.defense_active: routes/channels.php:43-44 — explicit comment + GOAL-CMS-2026-05-18 S-R3-P0-G hardening switched from tokenCan to token NAME check ('kiosk-token' exact match). Token name cannot be wildcarded.

attacks_attempted.attack: Guest user (branch_id=0 default) subscribes to arbitrary branch channel
attacks_attempted.vector: Customer signup creates User with branch_id=0 (sentinel). Old logic 'if branch_id===0 return true' would have allowed guest to subscribe to any branch.
attacks_attempted.defense: routes/channels.php:56 — explicit Role check ('Admin' OR 'Tenant Admin'). Guests lack these roles.
attacks_attempted.outcome: DEFEATED — R3 T-3.2.2 Sec F-SEC-W6-02 latent path closed.

attacks_attempted.attack: Stale KDS render after order cancellation
attacks_attempted.vector: Order created → KDS renders. Order canceled. KDS still polls 5s cache.
attacks_attempted.defense_first: OrderCanceled triggers ReleaseStockOnOrderCanceled + ReleaseAvailabilityOnOrderCanceled (EventServiceProvider:161-164). Status moves to CANCELED.
attacks_attempted.defense_second: KdsSyncService:120-138 — includeDeleted=true returns deleted_ids including status in [DELIVERED, CANCELED, REJECTED] (line 51, 126). Frontend removes the card.
attacks_attempted.remaining_risk: Cache TTL 5s — stale render window = max 5s before deleted_id arrives. Acceptable.
attacks_attempted.outcome: DEFEATED — eventual consistency window is bounded.

attacks_attempted.attack: Payload tampering via channel field injection
attacks_attempted.vector: If channel name comes from user input, could broadcast to wrong channel.
attacks_attempted.defense: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox:43 — channel hardcoded to ['private-branch.' . $order->branch_id]. branch_id sourced from Eloquent model (DB-trusted, BranchScope-enforced upstream).

attacks_attempted.attack: Envelope contract drift — listener writes payload missing required keys
attacks_attempted.vector: Future PR adds a new listener that writes payload without 'order_id' or 'queue_number'. Cascade should reject before broadcast.
attacks_attempted.defense: DispatchDomainEventsJob:110 — EventContract::assertEnvelopeValid runs BEFORE broadcast. REQUIRED_PAYLOAD_KEYS for ORDER_CREATED = ['order_id', 'queue_number', '_origin', 'payment_method'] (EventContract:56). Throws PayloadMismatchException, releases claim (line 161-166), retries via backoff, terminal failure stamped contract_violation: prefix.
attacks_attempted.outcome: DEFEATED — last-line defense at broadcast time.

findings_disputed.title: Cascade failure isolation INCONSISTENT across the 4 OrderCreated listeners
findings_disputed.evidence: EventServiceProvider:145-151 declares 4 listeners. Their failure behavior: (a) PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox = swallows broadcast dispatch error (line 67-78). (b) DecrementItemAvailabilityOnOrder = no try/catch, propagates throws. (c) DecrementStockOnOrderCreated = rethrows on Throwable (line 36). (d) SendFcmOnOrderCreated = isolates per-dispatch (safeDispatch :109-120).
findings_disputed.concrete_breakage: If (b) or (c) throws, (d) does NOT fire. Kitchen does not get FCM. Order exists in outbox/DB. Cascade is partially-applied — operator must reconcile via OSS/dashboard.
findings_disputed.cross_validates: PK1-ARCH-01 — same root cause (stale rollback mental model vs after-commit reality).
findings_disputed.recommendation: Unify all 4 listeners to catch Throwable + log + NOT rethrow once after-commit. The order is already persisted; throwing only hurts siblings. Coordinate with PK-4 RESILIENCE.
findings_disputed.scope_minimal_fix: 1-2 line wrap on each affected listener. Defer to PK-4 for unified policy.

findings_disputed.title: DispatchDomainEventsJob success path clears last_error but never marks 'recovered'
findings_disputed.evidence_read: Phase 3a clears last_error to null on success. No 'first_success_after_failure' metric or audit log row.
findings_disputed.impact: Forensic: if a row failed 4 times and succeeded on 5th, the previous 4 attempts are visible in attempts count (line 82) but the recovery moment is not stamped. Low impact for V1.
findings_disputed.recommendation: V1.0.X observability backlog — emit SyncMetricsRecorder.recordEventRecovered alongside recordEventDispatched when attempts > 1.

findings_disputed.title: FCM dispatch in SendFcmOnOrderCreated uses SendFcmNotificationJob — separate queue chain
findings_disputed.evidence_read: SendFcmNotificationJob::dispatch (default queue) is called 3 times per OrderCreated (kitchen, POS, customer). Each is wrapped in safeDispatch (isolation good) but uses Laravel's default queue connection.
findings_disputed.impact: If queue connection is misconfigured (sync driver in prod by accident), FCM dispatches fail synchronously. safeDispatch catches and Logs::warning, but kitchen never gets the push.
findings_disputed.recommendation: Healthcheck — assert config('queue.default') !== 'sync' at boot in production. Out-of-scope for this audit.

keeps_disputed_but_held: Outbox-first listener registration (EventServiceProvider:147) — the SSOT defense is the CORRECT mitigation for the inconsistent isolation. Even with PK1-RED-01 / PK1-ARCH-01 stale comments, the OUTBOX writes BEFORE any peer can throw.
afterCommit guard on event() — DispatchableAfterCommit:30-42. Drops on rollback. Cannot be reordered or bypassed accidentally.
lockForUpdate claim in DispatchDomainEventsJob:67-83 — proven by OutboxConcurrentWorkerDedupeTest.
EventContract::assertEnvelopeValid as last-line defense before broadcast — DispatchDomainEventsJob:110. New listeners cannot silently ship a malformed payload.
Token-NAME channel auth (routes/channels.php:44-49) — immune to Sanctum '*' wildcard. R3 T-3.2.2 Sec F-SEC-W6-01 closed.
